test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

INFO - NFIO - OFNI

OATH - ATOH - HTAO
solution:
The logic followed here is:

INFO - NFIO - OFNI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdbf0595549c020dd9c566fe0ed9be70990d1f99a5a70e2d6fa56a0ed0c796b7.png] 

OATH - ATOH - HTAO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cf51079efa94a29b6aaabf9f7acec833195f08f8663ba251dd81b69e80df65c.png] 

Now, let's check each option:

1. PLAY - LPAY - YLAP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/396d660efa0cecc03769985afbb9aa04cb7045c90dac0c06a005e0ff296d33c3.png] 

This group of triads does not follow the same logic.

2. REST - ESRT - TSER

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/400ed5eac60a7ac5d7bafdc689e1ae39ca52433c0f9dd94b71874120536ffa8b.png] 

This group of triads follows the same logic.

3. ALSO - ASLO - OSLA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0207f5c6567e4966e8729a4d83e5f1506eb61bb47633b74c6ce4387daad3352.png] 

This group of triads does not follow the same logic.

4. TINS - INTS - INST

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cec59d9bc07b6cedbc0e7da4c5967570020ad171c2e33602523323a470ef4ed2.png] 

This group of triads does not follow the same logic.

Thus, REST - ESRT - TSER is the one which follows the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
